title: 14 CFR § 107.41 Operation in certain airspace. (2025 edition)

heading_path: 14 CFR § 107.41 Operation in certain airspace. (2025 edition)
sections.text: No person may operate a small unmanned aircraft in Class B, Class C, or Class D airspace or within the lateral boundaries of the surface area of Class E airspace designated for an airport unless that person has prior authorization from Air Traffic Control (ATC).
